pokedexEntries.bk: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

pokedexEntries.wh: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

pokedexEntries.sw: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

pokedexEntries.sh: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
